name: Default
shortDescription: Teleport Auth and Proxy Service with the web UI, audit log and session recordings, reachable by tsh and agents over the single HTTPS domain.

alerts.message: No user exists after the first start. Run `tctl users add admin --roles=editor,access,auditor --logins=root` in the teleport container terminal, then open the printed invite link within one hour to set a password and register an authenticator app or passkey.

Only the HTTPS domain is published: agents join with proxy_server set to <domain>:443 and clients connect through connection upgrades. Application access on subdomains needs a wildcard domain that this template does not route.

The official Teleport Community Edition image is free for personal use and for companies with fewer than 100 employees and under US$10M annual revenue; larger companies need a Teleport Enterprise license.
